reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 affirmatively records that Customer has made no no-hire (or non-compete/exclusivity) commitment and remains free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment, which meets the preferred position of no non-solicit binding Customer.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the paragraph is returned unchanged.

The two failed deterministic checks (12-month duration, general-solicitation carve-out) are narrowing-language heuristics that presuppose an existing restrictive covenant on Customer; inserting such language where no covenant exists would import an adverse restriction, so the failures are properly discounted.
Correctly declines to flag § 12.4 (Vendor-side restriction) as it operates in our favour, consistent with the instruction not to flag clauses benefiting our party.
